turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What does this cost for twenty people? Is there an annual discount?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That price is beyond our budget. We cannot proceed at that cost.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want this but my director has to approve. Can we get her on a call?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We have approved the budget, I can sign, and all our questions are answered. Please send the contract today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We are interested but cannot buy until next quarter. Please call me in January.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sorry, wrong number. I was trying to call the pharmacy.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am starting to look for a car but have no idea what would suit me. Can you help me figure it out?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is the blue 2020 SUV on your website still available?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What is the complete out-the-door total with every tax and fee?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How does applying for financing work, and what down payment would I need?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have a 2018 sedan to trade. How do you work out the trade-in value?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The accident history worries me. I will not move forward until I see the history report.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to come test drive the silver sedan. Is Saturday at ten available?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I like it but my wife needs to be part of the decision before we proceed. Can we include her?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You have the wrong number. I am not shopping for a car.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will not visit until I understand the vehicle history.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We have sent you the available history report for review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have read it. That resolves my concern, and I want to test drive it tomorrow. What visit times are available?
